findings.title: Container is denied access to a mounted volume
findings.cause: container web runs as user 1000 and is denied access to /etc/tls/tls.key on volume tls (Secret tls): "cat: can't open '/etc/tls/tls.key': Permission denied"; the volume's files have mode 0400 (defaultMode) and belong to root, and the pod sets no fsGroup; Deployment web has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container web exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 6 times
last lines of container web's log (current run)
container web mounts volume tls (Secret tls) at /etc/tls

findings.fix: Let the container read the files: set fsGroup in the pod's securityContext and a defaultMode that gives the group read access (0440), or a mode readable by everyone (0444), on Secret tls.
